title: Oversight Game Theory: Under What Conditions Does Debate Lead to Truth Rather Than to Persuasion?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Direct and compelling: if debate favors persuasion over truth, it is not a reliable oversight mechanism. This is a fundamental question for the debate approach to AI safety. Addresses a core theoretical concern.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Requires designing arguments that independently vary truthfulness and persuasiveness, then running debate experiments. The experimental design is intellectually challenging but implementation uses standard API calls. Doable with mentor guidance on design.

narrow_scope.reasoning: If scoped to a single task domain with pre-constructed arguments of known truthfulness/persuasiveness, this is focused. But constructing the stimulus set (arguments varying independently on two dimensions) requires care. Feasible in 30 hours with good scoping.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Novelty not assessed due to partial Wave 3 completion.
